meta.purpose: Explain the product and drive sign-ups

cases.content:

image.name: holiday-post-Logo-Primary-2023.png
image.textInImage: HOLIDAY OFFER! Alpha is the best platform on the market

findings.key: IMG-LOGO|holiday-post-Logo-Primary-2023.png
findings.label: Old logo
findings.suggestion: Replace it with the approved logo asset, “Logo-Primary-2026.svg”. Please verify the image before publication.
findings.why: The file name matches a retired logo asset. Visual analysis can be uncertain, so a person should confirm.

findings.key: IMG-ALT|alt
findings.label: Missing alt text
findings.suggestion: Describe what the image shows in one short sentence.
findings.why: Images need alt text so screen-reader users get the same message.

findings.key: IMG-FONT|Comic Sans
findings.label: Unapproved font
findings.suggestion: Use an approved font: Inter or Playfair Display.
findings.why: “Comic Sans” is not in the approved typography list.

findings.key: img-T-NAME|alpha|holiday offer! alpha is the best platfor
findings.label: Outdated product name (in image)
findings.why: The product was renamed from Alpha to Nova. The old name must not appear in public content.
findings.suggestion: In the image text, change “Alpha” to “Nova”.

findings.key: img-C-BEST|the best platform on the market|day offer! alpha is the best platform on the market
findings.label: Claim needs a source (in image)
findings.quote: the best platform on the market
findings.why: “Best” and “leading” rankings are not backed by an approved source.
findings.suggestion: In the image text, change “the best platform on the market” to “built for local businesses”.

findings.key: IMG-PALETTE|#c4a000
findings.label: Off-palette colour
findings.suggestion: Dominant colour #c4a000 (about 31% of the image) is far from the brand palette. Nearest brand colour: Coral #FF6B5E.
findings.why: Visual analysis can be uncertain, so this is routed to a person.

findings.key: IMG-CONTRAST|contrast
findings.label: Possible low contrast
findings.suggestion: The two main colours have a contrast ratio of 2.4:1. Aim for at least 3:1 for large text and 4.5:1 for body text.
findings.why: Low contrast makes text harder to read. This is an estimate from dominant colours.

findings.key: img-V-CAPS|holiday|holiday offer! alpha is the
findings.label: All-caps wording (in image)
findings.why: All-caps words read as shouting and are harder to read with assistive technology.
findings.suggestion: In the image text, change “HOLIDAY” to “Holiday”.

findings.key: img-V-CAPS|offer|holiday offer! alpha is the best
findings.label: All-caps wording (in image)
findings.why: All-caps words read as shouting and are harder to read with assistive technology.
findings.suggestion: In the image text, change “OFFER” to “Offer”.
